plan.objective: Test price-only rules on actual token histories, without wallet actions as signals.
plan.universe: CS map markets from wallet's existing Oct27-30 sample plus public activity from Oct31 onward. Selection remains wallet-conditioned, so cannot infer all-PM profitability.
plan.window: Fixed UTC event-slug date minus 6 hours through plus 30 hours, not first/last wallet trade; 60-second raw history only.
plan.validation: Event dates Oct29-30 (previously inspected price data; exploratory)
plan.new_test: Event dates Oct31 onward, newly fetched after these fixed rules; not prospective live trading
plan.coverage_audit_amendment: Strict new_test excludes entire events previously inspected in the earlier 65-map study. Audit found zero overlapping new-test events; the reserved late_seen bucket is empty. Four older cached maps have Oct26 event dates and lie outside this fixed calendar scope. No trading rule or parameter changed.

rules.momentum: Token price +5 cents or more over 5 minutes AND last minute positive.
rules.rebound: Token price -5 cents or more over 5 minutes AND last minute rebounds +1 cent or more.
rules.pullback: Rise >=5 cents from t-10 to t-3; drop >=2 cents from t-3 to t-1; rebound >=1 cent from t-1 to t.

plan.entry: Signal and next reference execution price both 15-85 cents. Use actual token prices; no synthetic 1-p fills. One position at a time per map, fixed 100 shares, max 3 filled entries per map, 2-minute cooldown after exit.
plan.exit: At observed +8 cents, -5 cents, or 10 minutes holding, queue exit for next observation. Gaps/terminal missing executions marked separately, never silently removed.
plan.availability: Each 60-second bucket usable only after timestamp+60. Queue executes using a subsequent price point, at least 60 seconds after signal availability; also test 120-second delay. Irregular points must satisfy tolerance, no future-filled signals.
plan.costs: Sports fee coefficient 0.05 per leg, fee per share=0.05*p*(1-p), treated as explicit scenario pending per-market historical fee verification; no rebates. Slippage 0,0.5,1 cents per leg. Include gross zero-fee comparison.
plan.constraints: No parameter grid or post-test retuning in primary analysis. Report all three rules and no-trade benchmark. Bootstrap by whole event. No claims of executable fills from chart prices. Censored positions retain last mark and separate zero-payout downside stress.

caveats: Chart history is not historical bid/ask or depth. All simulated fills are indicative.
Universe was discovered from wallet activity; market selection is not independently price-only.
No full-account bankroll, concurrent allocation limit, rebates or execution queue model.
New test is newly analyzed historical Oct31-Nov1 data, not prospective trades.
Fee coefficient .05 is an explicit sports-fee scenario, not a reconstruction of every historical market fee.
Censored trades remain at last price mark; zero-payout stress separately counts full loss.
Closed-equity drawdown excludes intratrade unrealized drawdown and is not account drawdown.
